channel.title: Andalusia Star News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Andalusia Star News (andalusiastarnews.com)

item.title: Sumblin receives Agriculture Award
item.description: Martin “Andy” Sumblin, Auburn agriculture graduate and longtime Nutrien Ag Solutions leader, is honored as agribusiness industry honoree at the Alabama Agricultural Hall of Honor.

item.title: 483 area code implemented on Feb. 23
item.description: New 483 area code now overlays Alabama’s 334 region, affecting only new lines as 10-digit dialing takes hold across central and southeast communities.

item.title: BOE and Belton make history
item.description: Deirdra Belton, a lifelong Andalusia resident and childcare center owner, becomes the first African American woman on the city’s school board, aiming to inspire local youth.

item.title: ACS announces improvements to AHS softball facilities
item.description: Andalusia City Schools to add permanent press box, move bleachers, repair retaining wall, and enable live streaming as part of upgrades to Andalusia High softball facilities by 2027.

item.title: First Responder Spotlight: Rowell
item.description: Meet Wilson “Eddie” Rowell, a Covington County paramedic supervisor whose three decades in EMS span local care, church service, and disaster response across the U.S.

item.title: Andalusia AAC has a happy Valentine’s Day
item.description: Andalusia Adult Activity Center marks Valentine’s Day with dancing, refreshments, festive red-and-pink outfits, and a room full of decorations and smiles.

item.title: PTK project allows student to hire attire
item.description: LBW Community College’s Phi Theta Kappa chapter has launched a free “Saints Attire for Hire” career closet, offering professional clothing and guidance to help students prepare for interviews.

item.title: Andalusia Ballet makes final preparation for Sleeping Beauty
item.description: Andalusia Ballet brings Sleeping Beauty to the Martha and Solon Dixon Center Feb. 28 at 7 p.m. and March 1 at 2 p.m., with tickets still available at andalusiaballet.com.

item.title: DR. KING VISITS STUDENTS
item.description: County students visit LBW Community College for Bright Star Touring Theatre’s “The Life of Dr. King,” an engaging Black History Month show mixing humor, music and history.

item.title: Saturday | February 28, 2026 E-edition
item.description: Explore the full digital version of our February 28, 2026 issue and stay updated with the latest news and features.
